name: Ankylet · Gremlet #41
description:
An armoured ankylosaur covered in pinecone scales. Its tail club makes a great drum.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Ankylet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
